brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confronts his most precarious political position in years as his coalition fragments and legal challenges intensify, Al Jazeera English reported. The premier has repeatedly escaped politically damaging situations through calculated maneuvers, yet analysts suggest current circumstances may prove substantially more difficult to navigate.

Coalition partners have grown increasingly restive over Netanyahu's governance priorities and resource allocation, while simultaneous legal proceedings threaten his political standing. The convergence of internal party instability and external judicial pressure distinguishes this period from previous crises he successfully weathered.
dek: The Israeli prime minister has manoeuvred out of tough situations to retain power. But he may find it hard this time.
title: Netanyahu faces mounting political pressure as allies fracture
